trigger: Optional: Silver State Pawn on 4th Street (trader).

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: SILVER STATE PAWN — WE BUY GOLD. The neon is dead. The door is open. A man is eating peaches from the can.

nodes.speaker: trader_dutch
nodes.text: Welcome, welcome. Dutch Albertson. Everything has a price, my friend, and today the prices are very interesting.

nodes.speaker: trader_dutch
nodes.text: Cash? I'll still take cash. For about a week. After that it's kindling.

nodes.speaker: trader_dutch
nodes.text: Tools, a few guns, cigarettes, a very nice bass boat. Meds, if you don't ask where from.

nodes.speaker: trader_dutch
nodes.text: Batteries. Ammo. Jewelry, for sentimental people. And news. News is the new gold.

nodes.speaker: trader_dutch
nodes.text: Pleasure. You come back. Dutch remembers good customers. And bad ones.

nodes.speaker: trader_dutch
nodes.text: Also, a free tip: don't walk 4th Street after dark. The viaduct boys are hungry and not shy.
